title: Computing with many encoded logical qubits beyond break-even
abstract: Demonstrates quantum computations using up to 94 protected logical qubits with error-detection codes and up to 48 logical qubits with concatenated error-correction codes on the 98-qubit Quantinuum Helios trapped-ion processor. Logical gate error rates of approximately 1 error per 10,000 operations, significantly lower than raw hardware gate errors. Encoded computations achieve beyond break-even performance. Uses iceberg codes with only 2 ancilla qubits per code block (approximately 1:1 physical-to-logical ratio). GHZ states at ~95% fidelity across up to 94 logical qubits. Quantum magnetism simulation using 64 logical qubits showed ~30% reduction in effective error rates vs unencoded.
key_claims: 94 protected logical qubits using error-detection codes on 98-qubit Helios
48 logical qubits using concatenated error-correction codes
Logical gate error rate ~1e-4 (one error per 10,000 operations)
Beyond break-even: encoded computations outperform unencoded
Iceberg codes achieve ~1:1 physical-to-logical qubit ratio
GHZ states ~95% fidelity across 94 logical qubits
No logical errors observed in thousands of runs with concatenated codes
